annotations.title: Pick between two or three products

description: For two or three products, which one the buy-or-wait rules put ahead, or neither, optionally for a shopper's phone, owned device and budget, each with its verdict, fit, price and reasons; purchase_today and product_for_you split the better purchase from the better product. The same comparison as the decision card on idevice.com. For a line slug whose newest model is not on sale, the answer is for the newest that is, named in resolved_to. With buyer_context, buyer_decision and buyer_decision_info carry the personal answer the idevice.com decision page gives for it.

budget_usd.description: A price ceiling in US dollars

buyer_context.description: Optional. The shopper's own situation in the buyer-context-v1 grammar, set out at https://idevice.com/mcp/docs#buyer-context. A context outside it is answered with buyer_decision_info naming the fields to fix. It is used for this one answer and goes into no log.

owned_device_slug.description: product_slug of a device the shopper owns

owned_platform.description: The phone platform the shopper uses
